summary: First recorded activity since 18/11: Alex Gorcik started work on the particle shots, adding a new scene, Particle Explosion_V01.c4d, in a new Shot_03 & 04_Particles folder and exporting two first Redshift sparkler previs clips (sparkler_RS_previs_V01_ and A_sparkler_RS_previs_V01_) to 3D Exports. Alex also started an After Effects project for the lasers, Laser Grid_V01.aep, saved four times. The robot arm test was not touched, so its room previews are still at V05. Worth checking: Shot_03 & 04 and the laser grid are not on the Shots page yet, and the laser supplier, sync method and keep-clear areas are still open questions.

A quiet day: the only recorded activity was Alex Gorcik saving the new footage-on-shell test scene, Iktva Grand Hall_V02_TEST_ArchiveToShell.c4d, once in the early afternoon. No new versions, footage or renders were added, and the robot arm test file was not touched, so the room previews are still at V05 and still do not show the V02 scene or the 1.20 m eye height fix. Nothing has been rendered from the ArchiveToShell test yet, so there is nothing to review from it so far.

Alex Gorcik started bringing source footage into the test pipeline: clip A001C022_241203_ANKD.mp4 was added to the Test renders/FOOTAGE folder and converted into a 117-frame half-resolution JPG sequence (A001C022_half) under the Test assets/archive folder. A new test scene appeared alongside it, Iktva Grand Hall_V02_TEST_ArchiveToShell.c4d (saved three times), and the robot arm test file Iktva Grand Hall_V02_TEST_RobotArm.c4d was saved four more times. Nothing new was rendered from the room preview pass, so the robot arm previews are still at V05 and still do not show the V02 scene or the 1.20 m eye height fix. Worth checking: the ffmpeg log next to the image sequence (_ffmpeg_log.txt) is empty, so there is no record of the settings used for the half-res conversion.

Alex Gorcik moved the robot arm test scene on from V01 to V02 (Iktva Grand Hall_V02_TEST_RobotArm.c4d) and added an LED texture check image for an 8 m radius, 9.25 m high wall, the first work on that test file since 11/11. Nothing was rendered today, so the room previews are still at V05 and none of them show the V02 scene or the 1.20 m eye height fix. The LED sizes behind that texture check are still working values, as the staging team has not confirmed size, curve or pixel pitch, and the DELIVER scale 0.1 caveat on the test file is worth re-checking in V02 before anything is delivered from it.

Alex Gorcik spent the morning on Gen AI reference images, adding a first Shot_01 frame for each of four subjects: Crane, Scientist, Blacksmith and Shipworker. Alex also started a Photoshop mock-up for the robot arm (Robot arm mock-up.psd), following the crane mock-up from yesterday. No 3D files were saved and no new renders came out today, so the robot arm room previews are still at V05 and none have been rendered since the CAM EYE A height change on 12/11.

Alex Gorcik fixed the sweet-spot height in the robot arm test file: CAM EYE A in Iktva Grand Hall_V01_TEST_RobotArm.c4d is now at 1.20 m, matching the master, and 1.20 m is logged in STATUS.md as the eye height for every scene. Alex also started on crane material, adding a Gen AI reference image (Screen Image_Crane.png) and a Photoshop mock-up (Crane Mock-up area.psd). Worth checking: the robot arm test file still has DELIVER scale 0.1, so it should not be delivered from as it is, and no new robot arm previews were rendered after the camera change.

Alex Gorcik took the robot arm test room previews from V02 to V05, rendered v5 of the pitch film sequence, and saved a new test scene, Iktva Grand Hall_V01_TEST_RobotArm.c4d. In the master scene the DELIVER flat file pass was switched from Redshift to the Standard renderer, and that decision is now in STATUS.md. With the tracker now covering all of 02. Animation, it also picked up Alex starting Event Space Mock-ups_v01 in After Effects and adding Gen AI welder reference images for views 1 to 4. Worth checking: the robot arm test is in its own file, so its EYE A height and DELIVER scale still differ from the master and it should not be delivered from as it is.
